name: ToolbarRoot
description: Root of the Toolbar compound component, a horizontal row of buttons and inputs that users move between with the arrow keys. Shares `size` with the items inside it. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the toolbar buttons and inputs, controlling height, padding, and typography.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the toolbar. `outline` adds a border and background, `ghost` leaves the toolbar transparent.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every button and input in the toolbar, blocking all interactions.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: If `true`, using keyboard navigation will wrap focus to the other end of the toolbar once the end is reached.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Toolbar.Root.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
